zh: 献给波兰的“团结工会”——它于1980年开始了拆除共产主义的工程；也献给民主俄罗斯——它于1991年完成了这一工程。这两个运动本着一种自由民主精神行事，这种精神在东欧痛苦解放斗争中鲜有实现，但这一次取得了胜利；这一精神最早由十二月党人和亚历山大·赫尔岑以“为了我们的自由，也为了你们的自由”（
en: To Poland’s Solidarity, which began the task of dismantling Communism in 1980, and to Democratic Russia, which finished the job in 1991. The two movements worked in a liberal democratic spirit rarely realized in the painful liberation struggle of the Eastern half of Europe but on this occasion triumphant, a spirit first invoked by the Decembrists and Alexander Herzen with the watchword

zh: 在那场斗争期间，我有幸把这两个团体的一些领导人称为朋友。事实上，本书的缘起就是他们中某些人向我提出请求：推荐能够阐明其困境并指出出路的西方苏联学文献。但由于这些文献大多实际上传递的信息是：他们应当收敛异见，等待体制自行改良的恩典；因此，我满足朋友请求的唯一办法，就是对这些文献进行本书所呈现的批判性审视。
en: Some of the leaders of these two groups I was privileged to call friends during the course of that struggle. Indeed, this book had its inception in a request from certain of them to suggest Western Sovietological literature that might illuminate their plight and point the way out. But since most of this literature in effect sent the message that they should mute their dissidence and wait on the good graces of the system to reform itself, the only way I could meet my friends’ request was by subjecting Western Sovietology to the critical examination offered in these pages.

zh: 1989—1991年的崩溃并没有使这种批判变得多余，因为晚近事件表明，东欧从苏联遗产中解放出来的进程远未完成，而西方仍将继续有人发声，主张保留那份遗产中“有生命力”的部分。共产主义曾经如同涅索斯之毒袍，如今这件毒袍的碎片仍附着在它长久包裹的那些国家瘦骨嶙峋的躯体上——尽管已经染上了“民主社会主义”的颜色。
en: Nor has such a critique been rendered superfluous by the collapse of 1989-1991, for recent events demonstrate that the liberation of the Eastern half of Europe from the Soviet heritage is far from complete, and Western voices will continue to be heard advising retention of the “viable” part of that heritage. Shreds of the poisoned tunic of Nessus that Communism once was still cling, though now with a “democratic socialist” dye, to the emaciated bodies of the nations it enfolded for so long.
